unresolvedReferences.description: 從母 may be Emperor Ming's maternal aunt or a sister of Empress Yu's mother Lady Wang; the chapter does not fully disambiguate.
何氏 may or may not share the 從母 kinship with 荀氏; the wording allows either a second maternal aunt or another kinswoman.
The Minister over the Masses praised by Empress Chu is not named in this chunk.

The Princes of Donghai and Wuling at Emperor Yuan's accession are not personally named and are not equated with later title-holders.
孝怀皇帝 is cited as a ritual precedent; the chapter does not identify which emperor is meant.

宣太后 is named only as the shrine that received Li Lingrong tablet.
